errors.what: Wheel phase offset: slots appear rotated roughly 12-18 degrees counter-clockwise from where they should be, so the drive pin is not centred in the slot it is engaged with. At t=0 the slot should point exactly along -X toward the driver and hold the pin, but it is visibly tilted. At t=0.33 and t=3.67 the pin sits visibly off the slot centreline, outside the slot. The wheel's dwell orientations are also about 15 degrees off from 45/135/225/315.
